population.span: PATIENTS: 120 patients with a first recurrence of pericarditis.

endpoint.span: Secondary end points were symptom persistence at 72 hours

estimate.span: Colchicine reduced the persistence of symptoms at 72 hours (absolute risk reduction, 0.30 [CI, 0.13 to 0.45]; relative risk reduction, 0.56 [CI, 0.27 to 0.74])

ci.span: Colchicine reduced the persistence of symptoms at 72 hours (absolute risk reduction, 0.30 [CI, 0.13 to 0.45]; relative risk reduction, 0.56 [CI, 0.27 to 0.74])

treatment_strategy.span: In addition to conventional treatment, patients were randomly assigned to receive either placebo or colchicine, 1.0 to 2.0 mg on the first day followed by a maintenance dose of 0.5 to 1.0 mg/d, for 6 months.

follow_up.span: Secondary end points were symptom persistence at 72 hours

absent_reason: analysis_set: No source states the analysis population for this estimate. ci_level: The symptom-persistence interval is labelled CI without an explicit confidence level.
served_mismatch: The served RR 0.44 (0.26 to 0.73) is mathematically consistent with complementing the reported relative risk reduction 0.56 (0.27 to 0.74), but is not printed in any source. Under the exact-as-printed requirement, the directly reported absolute risk reduction is bound instead.

candidate_rejections.span: Colchicine reduced the persistence of symptoms at 72 hours (absolute risk reduction, 0.30 [CI, 0.13 to 0.45]; relative risk reduction, 0.56 [CI, 0.27 to 0.74])
candidate_rejections.why: Reject as a verbatim source for RR 0.44 (0.26 to 0.73): those values require transformation of the reported relative risk reduction. The endpoint and trial remain eligible.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The question includes first recurrence, which is the trial's stated entry population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: PATIENTS: 120 patients with a first recurrence of pericarditis.

notes: Abstract evidence used; no full text is held. RD denotes the printed absolute risk reduction, oriented placebo minus colchicine. No sign reversal or RR conversion was applied. Treatment lasted 6 months; the bound endpoint timepoint is 72 hours.
